THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 7
Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/6/2014/HW/298.
My Reference No.: 4/3/1/134-ii.
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire thefollowing lands which are required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Lot No. 1 to 141 (Lots 141) allotments in total extent of about0.8461 Hectare, of land in Preliminary Plan No. Ka. 4642 and dated30.04.2017, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys,Kaluthara on behalf of the Surveyor General situated in the villagesof Melegama, Mestiya and Mawala in the Grama Niladhari Divisionsof No. 703 Melegama North, No. 703B Melegama South, No. 705/BMawala, No. 700 Mestiya and Divisional Secretary's Division ofKaluthara in Kaluthara District in Western Province.
